beats.event: Convicted of murdering his wife and her lover; life in Shawshank
1948: asks Red for a rock hammer, claims mineral hobby
Requests a poster of Rita Hayworth for his cell
Repeatedly attacked by the Sisters, led by Bogs Diamond
Bogs is beaten near-dead by guards, allegedly at Andy's bribe
Overhears Hadley grousing about inheritance tax and offers help
Inmates get beers on the roof as Hadley's thanks
Becomes the prison's accountant; transferred to the library
Wins Maine Senate funding to expand the library
Tommy Williams says another inmate confessed to the murders
Warden Norton refuses to reopen the case; transfers Tommy away
Twenty days in solitary to break his spirit
Resumes laundering money to save the library
1967: tells Red of alias Peter Stevens and a hotel in Zihuatanejo
March 1975: escapes through a tunnel behind the poster
Norton resigns; Red gets a blank postcard from the Mexican border
Andy free in Zihuatanejo, hotel and boat bought with Norton’s money
Red, paroled, follows the letter to join Andy on the Pacific coast
